# What is the root cause and fix for the old Pinocchio's dh_dq for FreeFlyer world translation being non-zero, but the function value and CppAD showing zero?

> **Current answer:** The original author validated only changing the base position in q1/q2 to obtain the same centroidal momentum, and the maintainer later confirmed that the q partial derivative missed an item. This change has been merged into PR #1474 in the CoM translated dh_dq and dhdot_dq momentum blocks, and the finite difference test has been updated to directly compare hg/dhg. It is recommended to confirm that the target Pinocchio includes the merged submission d780648 or an equivalent patch; the thread did not provide a formal release for the first fix, and the original author's merged matrix is not the same as the new matrix after the maintainer's changes.
